summary: Berlin-based real estate partnership holding 14 residential and mixed-use buildings with rental income of EUR 11.4m. It was acquired in a 89.9% / 10.1% share deal by a Luxembourg fund and a German family office in 2023. Its tax position depends on staying below the RETT threshold, keeping the extended trade tax reduction despite rooftop PV systems, and on the interest barrier escape clause.

key_facts.label: Legal form
key_facts.value: GmbH & Co. KG, commercially imprinted through its general partner and therefore subject to trade tax

citations.quote: The partnership is commercially imprinted (gewerblich geprägt) through its general partner Nordlicht Verwaltungs GmbH
Target: Nordlicht Immobilien GmbH & Co. KG, Berlin.

key_facts.label: Portfolio

tax_areas.title: Share deal structured below the 90% threshold
tax_areas.summary: The 89.9% / 10.1% split avoids RETT only while holding periods are respected. Any rule change or transfer of interests within ten years could trigger RETT on a EUR 230m portfolio.

facts.label: RETT threshold
facts.value: Split keeps the acquisition below the 90% threshold; transfers within ten years must be monitored

citations.quote: The 89.9% / 10.1% split keeps the acquisition below the 90% threshold of § 1 (2a) and (2b) GrEStG.

tax_areas.title: Extended trade tax reduction at risk from PV expansion
tax_areas.summary: The extended reduction removes trade tax on rental income but tolerates only limited harmful income. The planned PV expansion would raise feed-in income from EUR 41k to about EUR 1.3m a year.

facts.label: Extended reduction claimed
facts.value: Claimed under § 9 No. 1 sentence 2 GewStG for rental income

citations.quote: The partnership claims the extended trade tax reduction under § 9 No. 1 sentence 2 GewStG for its rental income.

facts.label: PV expansion
facts.value: PV on six further buildings from 2025, approx. EUR 1.3m income per year

citations.quote: generate feed-in and tenant electricity income of approx. EUR 1.3m per year once complete
management plans to install PV systems on six further buildings from 2025

tax_areas.title: Interest barrier on EUR 60m shareholder loan
tax_areas.summary: Net interest expense exceeds the EUR 3m allowance, so deductibility relies on the escape clause. Changes to the interest barrier or arm's length rules for related-party loans would affect the partnership directly.

citations.quote: Principal amount: EUR 60,000,000. Interest: 6.5% p.a., payable annually.

tax_areas.title: Partly opted commercial lettings
tax_areas.summary: Residential lettings are exempt while about 18% of rental income is subject to VAT by option. Input VAT correction periods are running.

facts.label: VAT option
facts.value: Commercial lettings (approx. 18% of rental income) partly subject to VAT by option

citations.quote: Commercial lettings (approx. 18% of rental income) are partly subject to VAT by option
